_note: The one place the next-meeting card is configured. After editing, run `node tools/meeting-card.js` to rewrite the card in every page that carries it; `node tools/meeting-card.js --check` fails if a page is out of date. `ends` = HH:MM (24-hour, America/Detroit) when the card swaps to the after-meeting version; null = not supplied yet (renders a visible TODO).
